reaction_description: Carbonylation of an aryl halide using palladium catalyst, base, and carbon monoxide at 15 bar and 100 C for 3 h in batch.
raw_text: An aryl halide at 0.10 M is carbonylated using palladium catalyst, base, and carbon monoxide at 15 bar and 100 C for 3 h in batch. Design a continuous gas-liquid process with explicit CO containment and monitoring.
